import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    n = data[0]
    min1, max1 = data[1], data[2]
    min2, max2 = data[3], data[4]
    min3, max3 = data[5], data[6]

    # Maximize first-degree diplomas:
    # x1 must leave a feasible amount for groups 2 and 3.
    x1 = min(max1, n - min2 - min3)

    # Then maximize second-degree diplomas with remaining participants.
    rem = n - x1
    x2 = min(max2, rem - min3)

    # The rest goes to third-degree diplomas.
    x3 = n - x1 - x2

    print(x1, x2, x3)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
